2016 · Environmental activist · Corporate conflict

Berta Cáceres

Cáceres led opposition to the Agua Zarca hydroelectric project and challenged corporate, military, and political interests. Her murder transformed global scrutiny of development finance and environmental-defender killings.

2016 · Political staffer · Unsolved homicide

Seth Rich

Rich worked for the DNC during the 2016 election and was killed in an apparent attempted street robbery in which nothing was taken. His death became a major case study in politically weaponised misinformation and harm to victims' families.
